direction.purpose: User-approved creative campus identity, larger text, and interactive local event drafting; supersedes the rejected admin dashboard.

shadows.name: dialog
shadows.purpose: Elevate the temporary native help dialog; backdrop #101e37a8. Resting records stay flat.

motion.name: record-feedback
motion.purpose: Hover affordance on selectable records, translated -2px. Only enabled without reduced motion.

motion.name: action-feedback
motion.purpose: Immediate action state feedback; only enabled without reduced motion.

components.name: Draft field
components.description: Larger native field, distinct border, readable placeholder. Application title participates in validation and live preview.
